errors.note: 搜词假启动后未完成（未说出 competitive edge 等完整宾语）；like 填料可忽略，未完成句需标。

utterances.suggestionHint: I usually try to practice English in my spare time; especially recently, I would like to sharpen my competitive edge.

errors.note: The natural expression is "most of the time" without "in".

utterances.suggestionHint: So, most of the time I always try to keep myself energetic...

errors.note: After "help + object", use the base verb here: "helps the model gradually improve".

utterances.suggestionHint: Repeating the loop helps the model gradually improve its reasoning over time.
